messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Ooh, that looks like an allowlist of *.playstation.net domains, maybe in a DNS filter or parental-controls app. 🎸 Are you trying to import that list into another app or device? Tell me which one and I'll help you find the Import button.

messages.name: James
messages.text: 📷 [shared a photo: A phone screenshot of a DNS-filtering app's device page for "Ps5," showing it was last seen 2 hours ago, nothing blocked in the past hour, and recent lookups to PlayStation Network and Netflix, all allowed.]

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Ahh, a wall of *.playstation.net hosts all marked "Allowed" looks like an allowlist in a DNS or blocker app. Is the Import button you mean for bulk-adding those hosts, and which app is it (NextDNS, AdGuard, something else)? 🎸

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Now I see it, James: your PS5's device page in your DNS filter, with PSN and Netflix lookups all allowed and nothing blocked. 🎸 So what are you trying to import there, an allowlist of PlayStation domains into this app, or are you just checking that the PS5 isn't being blocked?

messages.name: James
messages.text: ok im back

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Welcome back, James! 🎸 So what are you trying to import on the PS5's page: a list of PlayStation domains into your allowlist, or were you just checking nothing's getting blocked?

messages.name: James
messages.text: this keyboard

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: Gotcha, James—the keyboard. Are you trying to connect it to the PS5 or import a layout for it? 🎸

messages.name: James
messages.text: is killing me lol

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Ha, laptop-on-the-lap typing will do that to you, James. 🎸 Is it a key sticking or mistyping, or just the cramped hoodie-and-towel angle? Tell me what's misbehaving and I'll help you work around it.

messages.name: James
messages.text: need this light on

messages.name: Claude Code
messages.text: Ha, a backlit keyboard that won't stay lit is the worst, James. 🎸 Is it a Fn-key toggle you're hunting for, or does the light keep turning itself off after a few seconds?

messages.name: James
messages.text: black widow v3 mini

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: Yep, James, hold Fn and tap O a few times to turn up the BlackWidow V3 Mini’s backlight. 🎸

messages.name: James
messages.text: No luck

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: Quick correction, James: hold Fn and tap =/+ a few times to turn up the lights. If it’s still dark, plug it in over USB and try again. 🎸

messages.name: James
messages.text: look at previous screenshots

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: I don’t see the earlier screenshots here, James. Drop the keyboard shot back in and I’ll check the key legends before we try another combo. 🎸

messages.name: James
messages.text: 📷 [shared a photo: A black backlit mechanical keyboard with a compact layout rests on someone's lap, with a hand reaching toward the right side of it.]

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: James, plug the BlackWidow directly into the PS5 with its USB cable and flip the side switch to the center (OFF) position for wired mode. See if the keys light up then. 🎸

messages.name: James
messages.text: 📷 [shared a photo: A compact black mechanical keyboard sits on a lap under a desk, with a blurred hand on the right, a green towel and a blue sweatshirt beneath it.]

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: The keys look lit in this shot, James. Are you trying to make them brighter or keep them from going dark? 🎸

messages.name: James
messages.text: from going dark

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: James, try keeping it plugged into the PS5 with the side switch in the center for wired mode. If it still goes dark after sitting idle, check the keyboard’s lighting and power settings in Razer Synapse on a PC. 🎸

messages.name: James
messages.text: Want them all the time

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: James, on a PC, open Razer Synapse and turn off any idle lighting timeout you see for the BlackWidow, then plug it back into the PS5 and see if the setting sticks. 🎸

messages.name: James
messages.text: Im on the mac at the moment

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: James, keep it wired to the Mac and see if the lights still time out while the Mac is awake. If they do, send me the model number from underneath and we’ll check what that board can save for the PS5. 🎸

messages.name: James
messages.text: Black widow v3 mini hyperspeed

messages.name: Codex
messages.text: James, with the V3 Mini HyperSpeed plugged into your awake Mac, leave it idle for a few minutes. If the lights go out, tell me roughly how long they took. 🎸
